summary: Iteration 21 frontend-only e2e of UX/UI 7 — Focus Mode + Lessons + Exercise Shell (/lesson/:slug internals). All acceptance criteria pass except one minor regression on scroll restoration. Waiter guest dc7d6048 (en) /lesson/welcoming-guests: focus-layout present, no bottom-navigation, counter progresses 1/8→8/8 across all 8 real engine steps (intro, phrases, dialogue, flashcards, listening, speaking, exercises, quiz). Deliberately mixed answers in exercises (wrong on MC1 and MC2, wrong word_ordering) returned feedback with data-correct=false and 'Not quite' + better answer; correct answers show data-correct=true + 'Correct'. Quiz 3/5 correct correctly reflected on completion as 'completion-quiz-correct = 3 / 5 correct'. completion-score=38%, dimensions English/Comprehension/Service rendered from backend. No 'master'/'maestr'/'domina' text anywhere on completion. Exit: × on intro step leaves immediately to /learn (no dialog); × after intro shows AlertDialog (lesson-exit-dialog) with Keep going (lesson-exit-stay-btn) + Leave (lesson-exit-confirm-btn); Keep going keeps lesson state; Leave returns to /learn. Completion-continue-btn opened next accessible non-locked lesson (guest-is-not-ready-to-order) starting fresh at 1/8. completion-done-btn present → /learn; completion-retry-btn present. Bartender guest a7f7c2a4 (es) /lesson/taking-a-drinks-order: Spanish UI confirmed (close aria 'Cerrar lección', intro-start 'Empezar', quiz 'Elige la mejor respuesta', 'Pregunta 1 de 5'); zero horizontal overflow at 390px throughout; MC role=radio aria-checked toggles true on select; fill_gap input has <label for> and font-size 16px; word_ordering tap-to-add adds all 8 words, tap-to-remove in answer area removes last word (verified count 8→7→8). Premium lesson for free bartender /lesson/serving-beer: lesson-locked shown with Spanish 'Situación Premium'/'Desbloquea las 25 situaciones…'; no intro leak; unlock button opens PremiumGate (account gate overlay). Progressbar role=progressbar aria-valuenow=8 aria-valuemax=8 on last step. Regression smoke: /home /learn /practice /progress /more all load 200 with bottom-navigation present (and absent inside /lesson/*). Console errors are only Firebase identitytoolkit 400s (expected per iter 20 context).

integration_issues.flow: Learn → Lesson → Exit → Learn scroll restoration
integration_issues.issue: After clicking lesson-exit-confirm-btn (or close × on intro) the Learn page returns to scrollY ≈ 185 instead of the stored value (~1500). sessionStorage key 'learn_scroll_y' is being cleared but scroll is not applied/held — likely a race between useLayoutEffect scrollTo(0, y) and the Learn list re-render (situations re-fetch on guestId/language change triggers a layout shift after the restoration pass). Spec explicitly calls out: 'Leave returns to /learn (and Learn scroll position restored when opened from a scrolled position)'.

action_items: Fix Learn scroll restoration after returning from a lesson: either (a) re-apply scrollTo(0, y) once situations finish re-fetching (not only on first mount), or (b) persist y in sessionStorage until Learn settles (don't removeItem until after situations stable), and defer scrollRestoration='auto' until after the final list height is known.
critical_code_review_comments: Lesson.js leave() uses navigate(-1) when history has entries — fine. requestExit() guards dialog for step>0 && step!=='completion' as spec. ✓
STEPS has 9 entries but totalSteps = STEPS.length - 1 = 8, so completion is excluded from counter — spec compliant.
Completion component correctly excludes any 'mastered' copy; score & dimensions only shown when backend returns them.
ExerciseShell/AnswerOption/FeedbackPanel are reusable and profession-agnostic — good separation.
FocusLayout: progressbar aria-valuemin/max/now and step counter rendered only when both current & total are finite — defensive and correct.

Lesson.js Completion: back-learn-btn only renders when nextSit === null; while loading recommendations (nextSit===undefined) a disabled back-learn-btn would render — current code shows it disabled, but spec mentions it; acceptable UX.
word_ordering shuffled uses Math.random inside useMemo keyed on q — stable per question, re-shuffles when question changes. Good.
fill_gap uses sr-only label + id, matches spec (label and 16px font).
No PremiumGate internal testid 'premium-gate' is exposed; account gate testid is 'premium-account-gate'. Minor — not a bug, just note for future tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: UX/UI 7 Focus Mode + Lesson shell fully validated at 390px. Listening answer required to advance (select option 0 then click listening-continue-btn twice: first submits + locks, second advances — flow is correct and already works). Speaking has 'speaking-skip-continue-btn' used when mic not available (headless). Only outstanding issue: Learn scroll not fully restored on return (~1500 → 185). All other acceptance criteria pass. Firebase 400s are expected ambient noise.
rca of the issue: Learn.js useLayoutEffect reads sessionStorage['learn_scroll_y'] and immediately removes it, then scrollTo(0, y). The removeItem makes the restoration non-idempotent: any subsequent re-render of Learn (e.g., recs or stats resolving a tick later, causing list height change) cannot re-apply the scroll. Mitigation: delay removeItem until after a stable render tick (requestAnimationFrame x2) or re-apply scrollTo after situations/stats/recs finish loading.
